title: Company update — week 3
text:
**Small charges nobody recognizes.** Since Monday, some customers have seen small card charges they do not recognize, mostly between $0.50 and $5. Screenshots are on X and Reddit; one post with many shares says "Cobalt got hacked".

Known: the charges are real; the security team is investigating with the card processor.
Not known: how many customers; what caused it; whether customer data was exposed.

experience.text: Cobalt posted a holding statement on social media within 24 hours: it is aware of reports of small card charges customers do not recognize and is investigating with its card processor; customers who see a charge they do not recognize can dispute it in the app.
You found a $1.99 card charge on your Cobalt card that you do not recognize.
You found two card charges of $0.89 and $3.49 on your Cobalt card that you do not recognize.
You found a $4.50 charge on your Cobalt business card that you do not recognize, and a market customer asked you whether paying on your Cobalt card reader is safe.
